about_the_game:
Why do fans go crazy and gachi defect one after another? Is all of this a distortion of human nature or a decline in morality? Can the main contractors turn the tide again? Play as your favorite virtual anchor, survive under the siege of fans, and collect as many resources as possible! Purchase various weapons and equipment, build the strongest bulid, and ultimately defeat the boss!

Game Features

  • The weapon is preset for automatic shooting, just control the direction and release the ultimate skill at the appropriate time! Fast pace, simple and refreshing!

  • Hundreds of props and weapons for you to choose from (a collection of various internet memes)! Match your character with various combinations to form the strongest combination!

  • Each wave of enemy attacks lasts for 20-90 seconds, try to defeat more enemies during this period and survive! Pick up as many light signs as possible!

  • At the end of each round, a powerful predator will appear! This big robot will constantly stick to you and seize your resources! It's all up to you whether to adventure and collect light signs or just leave when you see it's good!

  • There is a small chance of finding the legendary golden egg! Smash the golden egg to get 1-999 random light cards! Reverse the game with a big gamble!

short_description: This is a fast-paced battle and survival rogue game. Play as a broadcaster surviving under enemy siege, collecting resources and purchasing various equipment and props in the store to strengthen yourself, trying different combinations to constantly become stronger until defeating the final boss!
